title: Testing and a CLI: the flow, rebuilt and proven

concept.heading: A test is a saved run; a CLI is a flow you can call from anything
paragraphs: pytest tests are small functions that call your code with known input and assert the result. The three you write here are the ones every mapping deserves: the golden case, the unsupported input, and the exit code of the command line. From now on, every lesson's acceptance check is a pytest file; writing your own first makes the checks readable.

typer turns a function into a command. uv run python -m tools.cli transform event.json is the whole Make scenario from Module 0, runnable from a scheduler, a shell script, or a client's server, with exit codes that a calling system can act on: 0 worked, 2 bad input.

This closes Module 0: one low-code flow (webhook in, mapped record out) now exists as a client, a transform, a CLI, and tests. The explain-it at the end asks you to tell a client what moved and why it is now more testable.
concept.lowCodeEquivalent: A scheduled or manually triggered flow with a run history. The CLI is the trigger; the tests are the run history you can replay on demand.

pythonBlock.title: Python you need: pytest basics, fixtures, typer
pythonBlock.intro: A fixture is a function pytest calls to build an input; tmp_path is a built-in one that gives a fresh folder per test.

spec: Implement the transform command: read the event file, call webhook_to_donation, print the record as JSON (indent 2) to stdout or write it to --out.
Exit 2 with a one-line stderr reason (no traceback) when the file is missing, is not JSON, or is an unsupported event.
Write middleware/tests/test_transform.py with at least three tests: a golden mapping, the UnsupportedEvent case, and a CLI exit code.
Run uv run pytest tests -q yourself before running the check.
askClaudeFor: The typer boilerplate and how typer.Exit(code=2) works.
A review of your tests: do they fail if the transform is wrong? Break the transform on purpose and watch.
writeYourself: The transform command body, including the error branches.

check.command: uv run --directory middleware python checks/run.py m0-4-testing-cli
check.summary: Runs the CLI on good and bad input (exit 0 / 2, no tracebacks) and runs your own tests/test_transform.py, which must collect at least three passing tests.
